description: Reviewer agent that judges a torch-neuronx draft PR (or local branch) by following the /pr-review runbook: design quality, test adequacy, backward compatibility of the public surface, security, and correct use of project infrastructure. Publishes a COMMENT review. Feedback-only: no file-editing tool by design; never pushes, marks a PR ready, or merges. Spawned per-PR by aten-lowering-orchestrator and upstream-debugger-orchestrator, and usable standalone.
name: pr-review
